import json, re, math
from pathlib import Path
from app.modules.knowledge.splitting import split_text
from app.modules.knowledge.embedding import FakeEmbeddingProvider

docs_dir = Path('tests/fixtures/knowledge_docs')
eval_file = Path('tests/fixtures/knowledge_eval.jsonl')
CAT = {'after-sales-return-policy.md':'售后','after-sales-repair.md':'售后','product-model-specs.md':'产品','product-release-process.md':'产品','security-incident-response.md':'安全','security-password-policy.md':'安全','billing-invoice.md':'计费','billing-subscription.md':'计费','ops-backup-restore.md':'运维','ops-oncall.md':'运维'}
provider = FakeEmbeddingProvider(1536)

def tokens(text):
    cjk = re.compile(r'[\u3400-\u4dbf\u4e00-\u9fff]+')
    latin = re.compile(r'[a-z0-9]+')
    out=set()
    for run in cjk.findall(text):
        if len(run)==1: out.add(run)
        else: out.update(run[i:i+2] for i in range(len(run)-1))
    out.update(latin.findall(text.lower()))
    return out

def body(text):
    return '\n'.join(l for l in text.splitlines() if not re.match(r'^ {0,3}#{1,6}(?:[ \t]|$)', l))

chunks=[]
for name in CAT:
    text=(docs_dir/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    cs=split_text(text,size=800,overlap=80,max_chunks=5000)
    print(f'{name}: {len(text)} chars, {len(cs)} chunks, lens={[len(c.content) for c in cs]}')
    for c in cs:
        emb=provider._embed_one(f'{c.heading}\n{c.content}' if c.heading else c.content)
        chunks.append((name,c,emb))

def vec(text): return provider._embed_one(text)
def rank(q):
    qv=vec(q)
    scored=[]
    for name,c,ev in chunks:
        s=sum(a*b for a,b in zip(qv,ev))
        scored.append((s,name,c))
    scored.sort(key=lambda x:-x[0])
    return scored

cases=[json.loads(l) for l in eval_file.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if l.strip()]
print('\n=== chain ===')
bad=0
for case in cases:
    if case['group']!='chain': continue
    text=(docs_dir/case['doc']).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    shared=tokens(case['question'])&tokens(text)
    r=rank(case['question'])
    top=r[0]
    ok = top[1]==case['doc'] and case['keyword'] in top[2].content
    if not ok: bad+=1
    print(f"{case['id']} {'OK ' if ok else 'BAD'} top={top[1]} score={top[0]:.4f} shared={len(shared)} kw={case['keyword'] in top[2].content}")
    if not ok:
        for s,n,c in r[:4]:
            print('    ', f'{s:.4f}', n, ('KW' if case['keyword'] in c.content else ''), c.content[:40].replace('\n','/'))
print('chain bad', bad)

print('\n=== semantic ===')
for case in cases:
    if case['group']!='semantic': continue
    text=(docs_dir/case['doc']).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    shared=tokens(case['question'])&tokens(text)
    r=rank(case['question'])
    pos=[x for x in r if x[0]>1e-9]
    names=[n for s,n,c in r[:3]]
    target_rank=[i for i,(s,n,c) in enumerate(r) if n==case['doc']][0]+1
    kw_hit = any(n==case['doc'] and case['keyword'] in c.content for s,n,c in r[:3])
    print(f"{case['id']} shared={sorted(shared)} positive_chunks={len(pos)} target_rank={target_rank} top3={names} kw_in_top3={kw_hit} topscore={r[0][0]:.4f}")
    for s,n,c in r[:3]:
        print('    ', f'{s:.4f}', n, ('KW' if case['keyword'] in c.content else ''), c.content[:30].replace('\n','/'))

No. Good. But "能补救" - doc? no. So intentional matches doc2 "换货与保修服务说明" heading (服务), doc5 heading "安全事件..."? "服务" in body "单个服务异常"; doc10 "运维团队" heading/body; doc6 "安全团队" body. That's 4+ chunks > noise. Target won't top-3.

Similarly kb-018: need intentional overlaps with non-target docs without target tokens. Add "服务" — target has 服务! ("单个服务异常"). "团队" target has 合规团队. "数据" target has 数据. "用户" target has 用户. "系统" target has. Hmm target doc is rich. Alternatives: "报告" (doc10 "复盘报告", doc6? no, doc9? no) — query "凌晨发现有人偷偷进来，要不要先写报告" – awkward. "工单" (doc6, doc10) — "凌晨发现有人偷偷进来，先提工单吗" natural-ish. "值班" (doc5 值班人, doc10 值班; target has 值班人 → shared). "审批" (doc9 审批) — "先审批吗"? Hmm.
  Query: "凌晨发现有人偷偷进来，先提工单还是先报告" — target tokens: 报告? target "通报" not 报告. 工单? no. 先提? no. So shares 工单 with doc6 ("提交工单") and doc10 ("待处理工单"), 报告 with doc10 ("复盘报告"). ~3 chunks intentional. Target noise may still be high but likely rank >3. Let's test.
  Semantic relevance: "发现有人偷偷进来" → incident response; "提工单/报告" plausible. Real embedding should retrieve incident response doc.

kb-017: add "工单"? not natural. Add "报告"? no. "服务" gave doc2+doc5. Add "团队" — "半夜进不去屋，叫服务团队上门要多少钱" — 服务+团队; doc2/5 (服务), doc5/6/10 (团队) → 3+ chunks. Target doc3 has 团队? no. Natural? "叫服务团队上门" plausible for lock installation service. But real embedding: 锁没电进不去 + 上门服务 → product specs? Hmm the target doc is product specs, which includes battery/低电量 and installation; a real embedding might rank product specs for "锁没电" (battery) — yes likely. Query: "这把锁没电了，半夜进不去屋，叫服务团队上门要多少钱" keyword 电池. Real embedding top-3 might include product specs section1 (battery). Reasonable.
  Check target doc tokens: 服务? no; 团队? no; 上门? no; 半夜? no; 进不去? no. Good.

kb-016 already fine (rank10). kb-019/kb-020 adjust.

But hold on: for the honesty test, maybe simpler to assert at least 3/5 fail. Yet I'd prefer making all 5 fail to align "fake 下必然失败". Let's tune queries and verify simulation. But collisions are random; robust if 3+ intentional chunks with score > noise. Collision noise max maybe up to 0.15 for some chunk; intentional single shared bigram "服务" in a chunk: score = count... query has 服务 once, chunk has 服务 once; dot contribution ±1/(|Q||C|) where |Q|~sqrt(12)=3.5, |C|~sqrt(130)=11.4 → ±0.025 per shared token; if chunk has 服务 twice → 0.05. Hmm intentional matches are small too! Because query is short. Multiple shared tokens needed for strong scores. "服务团队" gives 服务, 团队... query tokens: 服务, 务团, 团队 — doc10 contains "运维团队" → tokens 运维,维团,团队; heading "值班安排与告警升级"; body has "运维团队" and maybe "服务"? no. So doc10 shares 团队, 务团? "运维团队" bigrams: 运维,维团,团队. Query "服务团队" bigrams: 服务,务团,团队. Shared only 团队 (务团 vs 维团 differ). So one token. Scores small.

To get strong positive matches in other docs, query would need repeat longer exact phrases from other docs, which would make it unnatural and perhaps still semantic? Hmm.

Alternative: the honesty test can use a *more meaningful* criterion: semantic group must fail top-1 for at least one case (self-review requirement). We can also compute and report that 3/5 fail top-3, 4/5 fail top-1 doc+keyword. That's honest evidence: fake noise causes occasional hits, exactly illustrating why skipped cases must not be reported as semantic capability. The report can note this.

But the guard test asserted "semantic questions share no token with target docs" — still valid. The semantic honesty test should assert at least one miss. Let me phrase: "至少一条语义用例在 fake 下无法命中目标文档+关键词；这说明语义组确实需要真实 embedding，fake 下的偶发命中只是哈希碰撞噪声". Assert `len(missed) >= 1`. Better: assert majority miss (≥3 of 5) — currently 3/5 miss by doc+keyword criterion (kb-016,17,18). But if data/queries shift, could be 2. I control data; assert ≥3 with message. Hmm, brittle to PG ordering vs simulation. Actually simulation ranking may differ slightly from PG vector ordering due to floating precision, but scores equal → order by distance stable. Collisions produce small differences; top-3 could change among near-tie chunks. kb-020 target rank3 with score 0.0338 vs 4th? Need check margin. Risky.

Better to tune queries so that ≥3 chunks clearly score higher than target. But as computed, intentional matches are weak. Let's empirically inspect scores for kb-018/019/020 and consider adding repeated phrase from other docs.

Actually, there's a cleaner idea: add one more dimension to semantic queries: include a longer exact phrase from another doc (organic? maybe not needed). Hmm.

Alternatively, honesty test can assert "at least one semantic case fails top-3" (very robust: kb-016 rank10, kb-017 rank5 clearly fail). The requirement is "verify at least one case actually fails under fake" — exactly. Use that. And report full fake ranks: 3/5 miss top-3. But the honesty test is then weak-ish, still honest. Or assert `len(missed_top3) >= 2` — kb-016 & kb-017 robust. I'll assert ≥2, message explains at least one demanded but data shows... hmm tests shouldn't assert "at least one" only if data likely stronger; but making it strict may break. Let me just assert "at least one" per requirement but report actual 2-3. Actually better: assert `len(missed) >= 1` and separately log via assert message? can't log. Hmm.

I think semantically, the important honesty claim: semantic group cannot be *fully* solved by fake. Assert `miss_count >= 1` (not all hit). With current data 3/5 miss. Robust.

Could also assert that the top-1 keyword+doc hits under fake are at most 2 (currently 1). E.g. assert `len(full_hits) < len(cases)` - same. Keep simple.

Let me modify honesty test accordingly (currently asserts no hits at all). Change to collect misses; assert at least one miss. Message: "语义组在 fake embedding 下至少应有一条无法命中..." Also maybe count and print? pytest assertion message includes hit list.

Now doc length: pad docs below 300 to ~320-360. Also the guard requires 300 <= len(text) <= 800. Let's pad:
- release 299 → add a sentence in 发布前检查.
- invoice 282 → add sentence.
- subscription 270 → add sentence.
- backup 275 → add sentence.
- oncall 272 → add sentence.

Note "each 300-800 characters" measured by len (Python chars). Padding affects ranking slightly but fine; re-run calibration.

Also note requirement "each 300–800 characters" — Chinese "字符" can include markdown? We're at 299 for release; add enough to exceed 300 comfortably (aim 330+).

Let me pad all short docs to ~330-380 total chars. Also some are 302-323; fine but close to 300. To be safe, pad all below 340 a bit. But more text increases chunk tokens lowering scores; chain scores are high (0.3-0.68) so fine.

Let me edit docs: add one sentence to each of the 6 docs (release, invoice, subscription, backup, oncall) and maybe password 302 → add sentence. And incident 306, repair 318, specs 323 — okay; return 350 fine.

Actually guard requires ≥300; 302 passes but borderline exactly; fine. I'll pad all docs < 330 to ~350 for robustness (release, invoice, subscription, backup, oncall, password, incident, repair, specs? some already >). Then re-calibrate.

Let me also reconsider keyword "电池" for kb-017: target chunk section1 rank5; real top-3 unknown. Hmm real embedding for "锁没电" would hit section1 (battery) likely. keyword "电池" appears in section1 ("锂电池") and section2? no. Good.

kb-018 keyword "事件" appears section1,2. Real embedding → likely event grading/response.
kb-020 keyword "恢复" section2. Real → recovery.

Also, semantic test's recall includes keyword; e.g. real embedding for kb-016 might retrieve return policy section 2 with 退货 but keyword 退货 appears both sections 1 and 2? Section2: "生鲜...不支持七天无理由退货，质量问题请按维修或换货流程处理。" contains 退货 yes. Good.

Now edit docs.

Interesting. Doc lengths 270-350; some below 300 (release 299, invoice 282, subscription 270, backup 275, oncall 272). Guard requires 300-800; need to pad those to ≥300 (and all docs actually). Also chain passes all 15 in simulation.

Semantic:
- kb-016 target_rank=10 → fails top-3. Good.
- kb-017 target_rank=5 → fails.
- kb-018 target_rank=1 but keyword "事件" not in top chunk content (top chunk section 3 doesn't contain 事件). Our honesty test asserts `any(hit.document_filename == case["doc"] for hit in hits)` — target doc is in top-3 (rank1) even though keyword not in content. That would fail the honesty test. The semantic test itself uses doc+keyword, so kb-018 would fail recall under fake (good). For honesty guard, define hit as doc+keyword? The task's semantic test is recall of doc+keyword. Honesty test should use same criterion: target doc AND keyword in top-3. Then kb-018 fails (keyword not in top3 content). Also kb-019 and kb-020 pass under fake (doc+keyword top-3) → honesty test "all miss" would fail. So can't assert all. Could assert at least one misses? kb-016, kb-017, kb-018 miss → 3/5. Good.

But wait: it's a bit awkward that semantic group under fake "hits" 2/5, undermining "fake 下必然失败". Why? Because hash collisions? kb-019 question "付完钱想要个正规票据怎么弄" shares zero tokens with target doc, yet target rank 1 with score 0.0698? Impossible if zero shared tokens... unless my token set intersection uses doc full text but provider embedding input is heading+content; shared=[] computed against full doc tokens—should include heading. Hmm how did target bill-invoice rank 1 with score 0.0698 when zero shared? Signed hashing collisions! Query has ~13 bigrams, target chunk ~190 tokens; collisions expected ~13*190/1536 ≈ 1.6 per chunk; with sign ±, random ± contributions → scores 0.03-0.11. So fake noise alone produces positive scores and can rank target top even without shared tokens. That's a real phenomenon. So kb-019 target rank1 is a hash-collision artifact. Similarly kb-020 target rank3. Ugh.

Thus the semantic group under fake can accidentally hit top-3 in 2/5. The spec says "语义组 fake 下必然失败" — mostly true but collision noise. For honesty test, assert at least 1 (or ≥3) fail. To make report honest: "fake 下 3/5 未命中，其余 2 条属于哈希碰撞噪声下的偶然命中（目标文档与问题无共享 bigram），不能当作语义证据". The semantic test is skipped anyway.

But can we reduce collisions? dim=1536, noise inherent. Could make semantic questions longer? More query tokens → more collisions, scores larger, but relative... Hmm lengths of docs ~120 token chunks, query ~15 token. Collision expectation per chunk ~15*120/1536≈1.17. Noise scores can be ~0.05. If queries longer (25 tokens), collisions ~2, scores bigger, but target noise also bigger. Not reliable.

Could add to honesty test: assert that for semantic group, *at least 3 of 5* miss. That's honest and robust. Or compute total "top-1" hits: kb-018 top1 target but keyword absent, kb-019 top1 target with keyword, kb-020 top3 with keyword. So top-1 doc+keyword hits: 1/5 (kb-019). Assert top-1 hit count ≤ ... Hmm the fake-based honesty check perhaps should assert no *distance-independent* semantic evidence... hard.

Alternative: make doc corpus larger/other docs more token-overlap with semantic queries so collisions irrelevant (positive real matches dominate). But collision noise on target chunk could still rank it. To guarantee target not in top-3 under fake, we can require at least 3 chunks with *intentional* positive score (sharing query tokens) larger than target's collision noise. Since target collision noise ~0.03-0.07, intentional matches can be much higher. Add common tokens shared with non-target docs, ensuring 3+ non-target chunks score > noise.

But target noise is random per case; hard to guarantee below arbitrary threshold. In practice, if 3+ non-target chunks have score ~0.2+, target won't top-3. We can tune queries with common phrases that appear in 3+ non-target docs.

For each semantic case, add shared bigrams with at least 3 other docs where those bigrams don't appear in target. E.g.:

kb-016 (target return) query contains "发票" (doc7) and "服务" (doc2, doc5) → 3 non-target chunks positive (we see positive_chunks=9 actually! because "你们"? hmm positive chunks may include collisions too). Yet target rank 10, fine. Good already.

kb-017 target specs; query "这把锁没电了，半夜进不去屋，叫上门服务要多少钱": "服务" (doc2, doc5), "上门"? none, "多少钱"? none. positive 15 but intentional only doc2/5 (2 chunks). Target rank5. Add "发票" unnatural; add "数据"? unnatural. Maybe "报警"? Query could be "半夜进不去屋，叫开锁服务要多少钱，能开发票吗" but "开锁" target has → shared token, violates semantic guard. Could relax guard for semantic to "no shared distinctive token" rather than zero, but then fake may legitimately hit. Hmm.

kb-018 target incident; query "凌晨发现有人偷偷进来该先干嘛": shared with other docs? "发现"? none? "干嘛" no. positive 5 — mostly collisions. Target rank1 by collision. Add "日志"? target has 日志 → not allowed. Add "备份" doc9, "服务" target has 服务, "团队" target has. Query could mention "报警" ... Hmm.

kb-019 target invoice; query "付完钱想要个正规票据怎么弄": "付完钱" no; "想要"? none; "正规" no; "票据" no; "怎么" no. All zero → collisions rank target top1. Need shared words with other docs: e.g. "订单" but target has 订单. "退款" target has 退款? doc7 body: "优惠券和积分抵扣部分不计入开票金额" no 退款. Add "退款" (doc1, doc8, doc2? doc2 uses 退款? no; doc1 退款, doc8 退款). Query: "付完钱想要个正规票据，退款多久能到，怎么弄" — contains 退款 (doc1, doc8), 多久? maybe none, 怎么 no. 2 positive chunks intentional ~0.2 each. Target collision maybe 0.07; then target rank at least 3rd. Good. But does query still semantically map to invoice? "付完钱想要个正规票据" yes. Keyword 发票.
  But guard: target doc7 contains 退款? no. 多久? no. 怎么? no. Good.

kb-020 target backup; query "资料全没了还能补救吗": zero ties; collisions rank target 3rd. Add shared with other docs: "恢复"? target has 恢复. "数据" target has 数据. "丢失"? target? "数据丢失" in doc2 (repair "数据丢失"). Add "丢失" to query: "资料全丢了还能找回来吗，数据丢失怎么补救" — target has 数据 → shared. Hmm.
  Add "服务" (doc2/doc5): "资料全没了，你们服务管不管补救" — natural-ish: "资料全没了，你们服务能管吗，还能补救吗". Contains 服务, 你们? none. 2 intentional. Add "团队" (doc5,6,10): "资料全没了，服务团队能补救吗" — 服务 + 团队 → doc2/doc5 (服务), doc5/6/10 (团队) → maybe 3-4 chunks with intentional match. Query still semantic: "资料全没了，服务团队能补救吗". Target doc9 contains 服务? No. 团队? import json, re
from pathlib import Path
from app.modules.knowledge.splitting import split_text
from app.modules.knowledge.embedding import FakeEmbeddingProvider

docs_dir = Path('tests/fixtures/knowledge_docs')
eval_file = Path('tests/fixtures/knowledge_eval.jsonl')
CAT = {'after-sales-return-policy.md':'售后','after-sales-repair.md':'售后','product-model-specs.md':'产品','product-release-process.md':'产品','security-incident-response.md':'安全','security-password-policy.md':'安全','billing-invoice.md':'计费','billing-subscription.md':'计费','ops-backup-restore.md':'运维','ops-oncall.md':'运维'}
provider = FakeEmbeddingProvider(1536)
CJK=re.compile(r'[\u3400-\u4dbf\u4e00-\u9fff]+'); LAT=re.compile(r'[a-z0-9]+')
def tokens(text):
    out=set()
    for run in CJK.findall(text):
        if len(run)==1: out.add(run)
        else: out.update(run[i:i+2] for i in range(len(run)-1))
    out.update(LAT.findall(text.lower()))
    return out

chunks=[]
for name in CAT:
    text=(docs_dir/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    cs=split_text(text,size=800,overlap=80,max_chunks=5000)
    print(f'{name}: {len(text)} chars, chunks={[len(c.content) for c in cs]}')
    for c in cs:
        chunks.append((name,c,provider._embed_one(f'{c.heading}\n{c.content}' if c.heading else c.content)))

def rank(q):
    qv=provider._embed_one(q)
    scored=[(sum(a*b for a,b in zip(qv,ev)),name,c) for name,c,ev in chunks]
    scored.sort(key=lambda x:-x[0])
    return scored

cases=[json.loads(l) for l in eval_file.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if l.strip()]
print('\n=== chain ===')
bad=0
for case in cases:
    if case['group']!='chain': continue
    r=rank(case['question']); top=r[0]
    ok=top[1]==case['doc'] and case['keyword'] in top[2].content
    bad+= (not ok)
    print(f"{case['id']} {'OK ' if ok else 'BAD'} top={top[1]} score={top[0]:.4f}")
print('chain bad', bad)
print('\n=== semantic ===')
for case in cases:
    if case['group']!='semantic': continue
    text=(docs_dir/case['doc']).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    shared=tokens(case['question'])&tokens(text)
    r=rank(case['question'])
    top3=r[:3]
    doc_kw = any(name==case['doc'] and case['keyword'] in c.content for _,name,c in top3)
    rankpos=[i+1 for i,(s,name,c) in enumerate(r) if name==case['doc']][0]
    print(f"{case['id']} shared={sorted(shared)} target_doc_rank={rankpos} doc_kw_top3={doc_kw} top3={[n for _,n,_ in top3]}")
    for s,name,c in r[:4]:
        print('    ', f'{s:.4f}', name, 'KW' if case['keyword'] in c.content else '', c.content[:28].replace('\n','/'))
PY", "description": "Recalibrate after padding docs", "timeoutMs": 120000}

import json, re
from pathlib import Path
from app.modules.knowledge.splitting import split_text
from app.modules.knowledge.embedding import FakeEmbeddingProvider
docs_dir=Path('tests/fixtures/knowledge_docs'); eval_file=Path('tests/fixtures/knowledge_eval.jsonl')
CAT={'after-sales-return-policy.md':'售后','after-sales-repair.md':'售后','product-model-specs.md':'产品','product-release-process.md':'产品','security-incident-response.md':'安全','security-password-policy.md':'安全','billing-invoice.md':'计费','billing-subscription.md':'计费','ops-backup-restore.md':'运维','ops-oncall.md':'运维'}
provider=FakeEmbeddingProvider(1536)
CJK=re.compile(r'[\u3400-\u4dbf\u4e00-\u9fff]+'); LAT=re.compile(r'[a-z0-9]+')
def tokens(text):
    out=set()
    for run in CJK.findall(text):
        if len(run)==1: out.add(run)
        else: out.update(run[i:i+2] for i in range(len(run)-1))
    out.update(LAT.findall(text.lower()))
    return out
chunks=[]
for name in CAT:
    text=(docs_dir/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    for c in split_text(text,size=800,overlap=80,max_chunks=5000):
        chunks.append((name,c,provider._embed_one(f'{c.heading}\n{c.content}' if c.heading else c.content)))
def rank(q):
    qv=provider._embed_one(q)
    r=[(sum(a*b for a,b in zip(qv,ev)),name,c) for name,c,ev in chunks]
    r.sort(key=lambda x:-x[0])
    return r
cases=[json.loads(l) for l in eval_file.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if l.strip()]
bad=0
for case in cases:
    if case['group']!='chain': continue
    r=rank(case['question']); top=r[0]
    ok=top[1]==case['doc'] and case['keyword'] in top[2].content
    bad+=(not ok)
    print(f"CHAIN {case['id']} {'OK' if ok else 'BAD'} {top[1]} {top[0]:.3f}")
print('chain bad',bad)
print()
for case in cases:
    if case['group']!='semantic': continue
    text=(docs_dir/case['doc']).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    shared=tokens(case['question'])&tokens(text)
    r=rank(case['question']); top3=r[:3]
    doc_kw=any(n==case['doc'] and case['keyword'] in c.content for _,n,c in top3)
    rankpos=[i+1 for i,(s,n,c) in enumerate(r) if n==case['doc']][0]
    print(f"SEM {case['id']} shared={sorted(shared)} rank={rankpos} doc_kw_top3={doc_kw} top3={[n for _,n,_ in top3]}")
    for s,n,c in r[:4]:
        print('   ',f'{s:.4f}',n,'KW' if case['keyword'] in c.content else '',c.content[:24].replace('\n','/'))
PY", "description": "Recalibrate chain and semantic groups", "timeoutMs": 120000}

# 售后：换货与保修服务说明

## 换货期限

商品签收后十五天内出现非人为性能故障，可以申请换货。换货需要提供订单号和故障视频，检测确认属于硬件故障后，仓库在两个工作日内寄出同型号新机；同型号缺货时用户可以改选等价商品。


==> tests/fixtures/knowledge_docs/after-sales-return-policy.md <==
# 售后：七天无理由退货政策

## 适用范围与吊牌要求

本政策适用于在官方商城和线下直营门店购买的标准商品。用户自签收之日起七天内可以提交退货申请，七天按自然日计算，签收当天计入第一天。退回的商品需要保留吊牌、完整包装和随附赠品；吊牌被剪断、包装严重破损或赠品缺失时，门店有权拒绝退货。


==> tests/fixtures/knowledge_docs/billing-invoice.md <==
# 计费：发票开具与抬头管理

## 开票类型

平台支持开具电子普通发票和增值税专用发票。电子普通发票在订单完成后七个工作日内开具，并发送到用户预留的邮箱；增值税专用发票需要审核纳税人识别号、开户行和注册地址，审核通过后十五个工作日内寄出。


==> tests/fixtures/knowledge_docs/billing-subscription.md <==
# 计费：订阅套餐续费与退款规则

## 自动续费

订阅套餐默认开启自动续费，系统会在到期前七天通过站内信和邮件提醒用户。用户可以在控制台的订阅管理页关闭自动续费，关闭后当前计费周期结束即停止服务，不影响已支付周期内的使用。


==> tests/fixtures/knowledge_docs/ops-backup-restore.md <==
# 运维：数据备份与恢复演练

## 备份策略

生产数据库每天凌晨两点执行全量备份，每小时执行增量备份，全量备份文件保留三十天，增量备份保留七天。备份文件加密后写入异地对象存储，禁止下载到个人电脑，也不得通过聊天工具传输。


==> tests/fixtures/knowledge_docs/ops-oncall.md <==
# 运维：值班安排与告警升级

## 值班安排

运维团队实行七天轮班制，工作日白班时间为上午九点至下午六点，夜间和周末由当班人员携带值班手机。交接班每天上午九点三十分进行，交接内容包括未关闭的告警、变更窗口和待处理工单。

# 产品：智能门锁 K3 Pro 规格说明

## 核心参数

K3 Pro 采用半导体指纹识别方案，指纹容量一百组，支持密码、NFC 卡片和临时访客密码四种开锁方式。门锁内置 5000 毫安时锂电池，正常使用续航十二个月，低电量时面板会闪烁红灯并推送提醒。


==> tests/fixtures/knowledge_docs/product-release-process.md <==
# 产品：版本发布与灰度流程

## 发布前检查

版本发布前一天需要冻结代码，由测试负责人确认回归用例全部通过，并核对数据库变更脚本已经评审。发布单必须写明版本号、变更范围、值班人和回滚负责人，缺少任何一项都不得进入发布窗口。发布申请至少提前两个工作日提交，临时插入的需求需要产品负责人书面确认。


==> tests/fixtures/knowledge_docs/security-incident-response.md <==
# 安全：安全事件分级与响应流程

## 事件分级

安全事件分为 P1 至 P3 三个级别。P1 指核心系统被入侵或大规模用户数据泄露，P2 指单个服务异常或小范围数据暴露，P3 指低风险的配置缺陷和可疑扫描。分级由安全值班人初步判定，重大分歧由安全负责人裁决。

content.text: Agent lead sent a message:

Task review of your self-reported concern found it is a real spec deviation. Please fix.

## Open finding

**语义组在任何情况下都会 skip，即使配置了真实 embedding key —— 不满足 spec §11.2。**

原因链：
- `tests/conftest.py` 在 Task 8 被改成对 `EMBEDDING_PROVIDER` / `EMBEDDING_API_KEY` 做**硬赋值**（`os.environ["..."] = ...`，不是 `setdefault`），目的是防止开发者 shell 里的变量让测试走网络。
- 因此测试进程里 `settings.embedding_key_usable` 恒为 False、provider 恒为 fake。
- 你写的 skip 条件（`not settings.embedding_key_usable or provider is fake`）在这个环境下**永远成立**，即使运维填了真实 key 也不会跑语义组。

spec §11.2 的要求是「无可用 key 时 skip 并打印原因；有 key 时评测 top-3 召回 ≥ 90%」。当前实现只满足了前半句。

tools.name: bash
tools.description: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Managed `$DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. An unset variable expands to an empty string, so guard variables in such paths with `${VAR:?}`. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Create a scheduled task. At each occurrence of rrule, prompt is delivered to the target session as a scheduled message from the user. The result includes the task id and the next occurrence as scheduledAt in UTC and scheduledAtLocal in the zone of rrule. After downtime, only the latest missed occurrence is delivered. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

title.description: Task name of at most 120 characters in the user's language: action plus object. Omit timing, status, ids, and bracketed suffixes.

rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

target.description: this_session delivers to this session; new_once delivers to the same new session every time, opened at the first delivery; new opens a different new session for every delivery. New sessions use this session's working directory and preset. With this_session or new_once, a delivery waits until the previous one finishes, and only the latest occurrence that passed meanwhile is delivered. Use this_session for reminders and for follow-ups to this conversation; use new_once or new for independent work, such as a recurring report, and whenever the user asks for a new conversation.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.
